blackest.songTitle: I Will Follow You into the Dark
blackest.linePrev: But it's nothing to cry about 'cause we'll hold each other soon
blackest.lineNext: And if Heaven and Hell decide that they both are satisfied
stanza: You and me have seen everything to see
From Bangkok to Calgary and the soles of your shoes
Are all worn down, the time for sleep is now
But it's nothing to cry about 'cause we'll hold each other soon

blackest.linePrev: All the world is all I am
blackest.line: The black of the blackest ocean
blackest.lineNext: And the tear in your hand
stanza: All the world is all I am
The black of the blackest ocean
And the tear in your hand
Dangling, dangling, dangling for me, darling
You don't know the power that you have
With that tear in your hand
